citation: Early, D. M., Berg, J. K., Alicea, S., Si, Y., Aber, J. L., Ryan, R. M., & Deci, E. L. (2016). The impact of Every Classroom, Every Day on high school student achievement: Results from a school-randomized trial. Journal of Research on Educational Effectiveness, 9(1), 3-29. https://doi.org/10.1080/19345747.2015.1055638
report_number: Journal of Research on Educational Effectiveness 9(1), 3-29 (ERIC EJ1089961)
design: Cluster-RCT; school-level random assignment stratified within 5 districts; 20 high schools (10 treatment, 10 control) in 4 states; subjects math + ELA; grade 9 in Year 1, grade 10 in Year 2 (high school). Intent-to-treat HLM (2-level, students nested in schools), pretest- and demographic-adjusted.
problems: ICC reported only as a range (.06-.09 across math/ELA and the two years; authors note it resembles the .08 average for low-achieving schools per Hedges & Hedberg 2007), not broken out per outcome/year; recorded 0.08 as the central design-effect ICC with a per-row note. Outcome scores were standardized within test and district, so the control-group SD used to standardize each effect (the paper's stated g denominator) is near 1.0 but not reported numerically per outcome; g_se/g_var were obtained by scaling the HLM impact SE by the same factor (ES/b) the authors used to convert b to g. Per-arm n for Year 1 (n=7,184) not split into treatment/control in the report; only the Year 2 total split is given (3,935 T / 4,315 C). The author short-cite 'Early et al. 2016' is the ECED study (lead author Diane M. Early); confirmed via OpenAlex/ERIC against the registry profile (School RCT, grades 7-12, Low SES, (P)CK, Long, Res/Dev).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Every Classroom, Every Day (ECED) full supports vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: District/state standardized math tests (CST, TCAP/EOC, AIMS, NYSTP/Regents), pooled & standardized within test and district
effect_sizes.g_method: Paper's reported Hedges' g (Table 3, Model 2) = HLM intervention-effect estimate (b=0.133) / raw control-group SD of the standardized math outcome; g_se = impact_se * (g/b) = 0.061 * (0.14/0.133) = 0.0642; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.notes: Co-primary outcome. Statistically significant favoring ECED (b=0.133, SE=0.061, p=0.048). End-of-treatment (2-year) wave; this is the wave to extract. ICC range .06-.09 across outcomes/years; 0.08 recorded as central design-effect ICC. SE from 2-level HLM accounts for clustering of students within 20 schools (cluster_adjusted=true).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Every Classroom, Every Day (ECED) full supports vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: District/state standardized ELA/reading tests (CST, TCAP, Stanford 10/AIMS, Regents, GMRT), pooled & standardized within test and district
effect_sizes.g_method: Paper's reported Hedges' g (Table 3, Model 2) = HLM intervention-effect estimate (b=0.063) / raw control-group SD of the standardized ELA outcome; g_se = impact_se * (g/b) = 0.052 * (0.06/0.063) = 0.0495; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.notes: Co-primary outcome. Not statistically significant (b=0.063, SE=0.052, p=0.248). End-of-treatment (2-year) wave; this is the wave to extract. ICC range .06-.09; 0.08 recorded as central design-effect ICC. SE from 2-level HLM accounts for clustering (cluster_adjusted=true).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Every Classroom, Every Day (ECED) full supports vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.test_name: District/state standardized math tests, pooled & standardized within test and district
effect_sizes.g_method: Paper's reported Hedges' g (Table 3, Model 2) = HLM impact estimate (b=0.164) / raw control-group SD; g_se = 0.080 * (0.17/0.164) = 0.0829; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.notes: INTERIM (Year 1) wave, NOT the end-of-treatment measurement; provided for completeness. Year 1 total n=7,184 (treatment/control split not reported separately). Marginally significant (b=0.164, SE=0.080, p=0.060). Prefer the Year 2 Math row for central analysis; exclude this row centrally to avoid double-counting the same arm-outcome at an earlier wave.
